## Problem

What are you trying to do that isn't currently supported? Link to the
relevant section of the [README](../../README.md) or
[DEVELOPMENT.md](../../DEVELOPMENT.md) if it touches a documented contract
(networking, ownership, cleanup invariants).

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see added or changed?

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you're using today, or other approaches you considered.

## Supported-scope impact

Does this fit the current [supported scope](../../README.md#supported-scope)
(Ubuntu 24.04, `linux/amd64`, RKE2, Cilium native routing)? If it extends
that scope, say so explicitly.

## Additional context

Anything else — links, sketches, related issues.
